mentions.note: 2nd in Brighton Walk 1927 on first attempt; won Club Open Walk 1927
ten years ago (1927-28): first three in the 10 miles Walk
Belgrave Open Walk scratch team (ten years earlier)
"our own"; won the 50 km walk at the 1932 Games

Olympic 50,000 metre walk champion, Los Angeles 1932, in 4 hrs. 50 mins. 10 secs.; Manchester to Blackpool Walk winner several times; broke 50 miles record August 1930 in the Nottingham to Birmingham Walk
